import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem continuous_strict_gap_side
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (p : X → Y) (C : Set Y)
    (hD : ConnectedSpace {x : X // p x ∈ C})
    (f : {x : X // p x ∈ C} → ℝ)
    (hf : Continuous f)
    (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (hd : ∀ x, f x < a ∨ b < f x) :
    (∀ x, f x < a) ∨ (∀ x, b < f x) := by
  haveI := hD
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  rcases h with ⟨⟨x₁, hx₁⟩, ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩⟩
  have h1 : b < f x₁ := by
    rcases hd x₁ with h | h
    · linarith
    · exact h
  have h2 : f x₂ < a := by
    rcases hd x₂ with h | h
    · exact h
    · linarith
  have hconn : IsPreconnected (Set.range f) := by
    rw [← Set.image_univ]
    exact isPreconnected_univ.image f hf.continuousOn
  rw [isPreconnected_iff_ordConnected] at hconn
  have ha_in_Icc : a ∈ Set.Icc (f x₂) (f x₁) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have ha_in_range : a ∈ Set.range f :=
    hconn.out (Set.mem_range_self x₂) (Set.mem_range_self x₁) ha_in_Icc
  rcases ha_in_range with ⟨z, hz⟩
  rcases hd z with hlt | hgt
  · linarith
  · linarith

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem continuous_strict_gap_side
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (p : X → Y) (C : Set Y)
    (hD : ConnectedSpace {x : X // p x ∈ C})
    (f : {x : X // p x ∈ C} → ℝ)
    (hf : Continuous f)
    (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (hd : ∀ x, f x < a ∨ b < f x) :
    (∀ x, f x < a) ∨ (∀ x, b < f x) := by
  classical
  letI : ConnectedSpace {x : X // p x ∈ C} := hD
  
  by_cases hlow : ∀ x, f x < a
  · exact Or.inl hlow
  · right
    obtain ⟨xH, hxH⟩ := not_forall.mp hlow
    have hxH' : b < f xH := (hd xH).resolve_left hxH
  
    have hpre :
        IsPreconnected (Set.univ : Set {x : X // p x ∈ C}) :=
      (isConnected_univ :
        IsConnected (Set.univ : Set {x : X // p x ∈ C})).isPreconnected
  
    intro x
    rcases hd x with hxlow | hxhigh
    · exfalso
      have hm :
          (a + b) / 2 ∈ Set.Icc (f x) (f xH) := by
        constructor <;> linarith
  
      have him :
          (a + b) / 2 ∈ f '' (Set.univ : Set {x : X // p x ∈ C}) :=
        (hpre.intermediate_value (f := f)
          (Set.mem_univ x) (Set.mem_univ xH) hf.continuousOn) hm
  
      rcases him with ⟨z, hz, hzval⟩
      rcases hd z with hzlow | hzhigh
      · linarith [hzval]
      · linarith [hzval]
    · exact hxhigh
